content: Next.js 15+ static export uses output:'export' in next.config.ts. Generates to out/ directory. Requires images:{unoptimized:true} for static hosting. trailingSlash:true recommended for GitHub Pages. basePath needed for project pages (username.github.io/repo-name/), omitted for custom domains. App Router (v13+) supports static export with React Server Components. No next export command since v14 — use output:'export' config instead.
